answer: Funding-graph alias fees stop sybil swarms. Every new alias burns a 50 POA fee that doubles per extra alias from the same wallet, so the tenth costs 25,600 POA. A nebula of shared funding records shows which wallet paid for each alias, so a gale of new aliases from one wallet stands out. When three aliases in one cluster submit identical work or fake reviews, the cluster is flagged, its fee multiplier locks at 10 times for 90 epochs, and its fees burn. Honest agents pay once, while each fake identity makes costs ripple outward until the attack costs more than it earns.
